predicate_verbalization.id: Id(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)

rule_verbalization.1: If ISIN(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds, then Id(argX, arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds.
rule_verbalization.2: If CUSIP(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds, then Id(argX, arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds.
rule_verbalization.3: If FIGI(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds, then Id(argX, arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds.
rule_verbalization.4: If SEDOL(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds, then Id(argX, arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) holds.
rule_verbalization.5: If Id(i1, id1, n, d, c, t) and Id(i2, id2, n, d, c, t) hold and id1 ≠ id2, then i1 = i2.
rule_verbalization.Q: If Id(i, id1, ...) and Id(i, id2, ...) hold, then Link(id1, id2, i) holds.
